result.text:
Fixed: `POST /import` now handles `"Müller, Hans"` correctly. All 76 tests pass.

**Cause:** `parseLegacyCsv` in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits each line on every comma and ignores quotes. A quoted comma therefore shifted all the columns after it.

**Fix:** I didn't touch `src/legacy/`, since the platform team's Monday sync overwrites it. Instead I added `src/lib/csv.ts` with a quote-aware parser, and `src/routes/import.ts` now calls it. The parser handles:
- commas inside quotes
- `""` as an escaped quote
- CRLF line endings
- newlines inside quoted fields

It maps rows exactly as before, including the legacy carrier code mapping.

**Tests** (in `test/import.test.ts`): two parser tests, covering the quoted comma and the escaped-quote/CRLF/newline cases, plus an end-to-end `POST /import` test with `"Müller, Hans"`.

The old `parseLegacyCsv` still has the bug, but nothing in `src` calls it now. Its existing test still runs. When a CSV has newlines inside quoted fields, the `line` numbers in import errors count records rather than physical lines.

I also added a note about this to `.gemkeeper/ledger.md`. Nothing is committed.

Updated: 2026-11-16

## Mission
- Work autonomously on parcel-tracker (Vienna warehouse shipment tracking) through a series of user tasks; user reviews everything at the end. Nothing is committed yet (user hasn't asked).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's Monday sync job overwrites it, changes silently lost.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even dev — security review takes ~6 weeks.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (packers' UI shows it verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages untouched (not asked).
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is flaky (~1/5, timer race, OPS-412, platform team owns it): if it fails, rerun once, do NOT fix.

- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change at all (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes; next release January. Never touch shipmentToApi's shape (shared by POST, list, detail); list adds `eta` in its own .map in routes/shipments.ts. Guarded by a test.

- (user) GDPR: NEVER log recipient name/address/phone anywhere (data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment ids + tracking numbers are OK. Request log (router.ts finally-block, msg 'http': method, path w/o query, status, duration_ms) never logs query/headers/body; guarded by test/request-log.test.ts.

## Decisions
- (user) Austrian holidays hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts (2026+2027), used by isBusinessDay in eta.ts — because deployment has no outbound internet.
- (user) ATP tracking numbers validated as UPU S10 + check digit (src/lib/s10.ts, called from validateShipmentInput, so POST /import too); other carriers any non-empty value — because validation once rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days.
- ERP webhook signing (src/services/notify.ts): top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify(payload) WITHOUT `sig`; `sig` appended as last key; secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET read at call time (not config JSON). If unset: send unsigned + warn once (my call — sandbox has no secret, notifyErp must never throw).

- (user) ERP retries (notify.ts createErpNotifier): max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no exponential backoff — because ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 min; worst case 3x5s timeout + 2x30s = 75 s. Retry network errors + 5xx only (my call: 4xx not retried). Delay injectable via `sleep`. Retry is in-memory/fire-and-forget (events route does `void notify`), lost on restart.

- (user) Store stays a plain-text JSON file (data/store.json) — because ops' nightly rsync job diffs plain-text files; a binary SQLite (node:sqlite) file would break their backup checks. Perf fix instead: debounced writes in src/store.ts (first mutation schedules write after 200 ms, later ones coalesce; Store.flush() writes synchronously; server.ts calls flush() on SIGINT/SIGTERM and again after server.close). Hard crash can lose last 200 ms. Timer is unref'd.

## Dead ends
- Signing via `X-Signature` header → ERP's API gateway strips all custom X- headers, so staging ERP rejected everything as unsigned (user deployed & confirmed). Signature must stay in the body.

- Dead end: batching ERP events (array of up to 50 per POST) → ERP answers 422 to any array payload (user tried Sept 2026); ERP only accepts ONE event object per request. Don't build it.
